adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, the API requires `usernames` to be a comma-delimited string (`usernames = params.require(:usernames)` then `usernames.split(",")`). If a client sends an array, this will raise (`Array` has no `split`). The updated spec also explicitly `join(",")`, reflecting this coupling. This is a real, diff-grounded API design/architecture concern (UI serialization format leaking into the endpoint), but not a verifiable functional bug given the JS caller (`Group#addMembers`) passes a single `usernames` value that appears to be the intended comma-separated format.
